metadata.title: LipoKG: A Knowledge Graph Dataset for Lipoprotein Metabolism Research
metadata.description: A comprehensive FAIR-compliant knowledge graph integrating multi-source data for lipoprotein metabolism research. This dataset combines protein-protein interactions (STRING v12.0), genetic variants (ClinVar), disease associations (DisGeNET, OMIM, GWAS Catalog, Orphanet), and pathway information (KEGG, Reactome, WikiPathways) into a unified graph structure. The knowledge graph contains 6,052 core nodes and 36,559 core edges (extended Neo4j schema: 6,463 nodes, 37,165 edges), with 84.8% coverage of reference lipoprotein metabolism genes across three pathway databases. Independent validation achieves 92.3% coverage of GO:0042157 (lipoprotein metabolic process). This dataset is designed to support systematic knowledge gap discovery, drug repurposing research, and precision medicine applications in cardiovascular disease.

files.description: Comprehensive documentation including dataset description, schema, usage examples, and citation information
Quick start guide for using LipoKG with Neo4j and Python
Detailed schema documentation describing node types, relationship types, and data model
BioLinkML-compliant schema definition file
Example Cypher queries for common use cases
Tutorial demonstrating four real-world use cases
1,852 protein nodes from STRING database with Ensembl IDs and descriptions
31,878 protein-protein interaction edges from STRING with confidence scores
4,042 ClinVar variant nodes with clinical significance information (3-step filtered)
4,042 variant-gene relationship edges from ClinVar
27 disease nodes related to lipoprotein metabolism with MONDO IDs
318 gene-disease association edges from DisGeNET, OMIM, GWAS Catalog, and Orphanet
57 molecule nodes including drugs and metabolites relevant to lipoprotein metabolism
7 lipoprotein particle nodes (CM, VLDL, IDL, LDL, HDL, Lp(a), Chylomicron Remnant)
48 protein-particle composition edges
8 protein-particle assembly relationship edges
23 enzyme-particle modification edges (MODIFIES relationships)
52 gene nodes from KEGG pathway hsa04979
15 pathway nodes from KEGG, Reactome, and WikiPathways
242 gene-pathway membership edges
Comprehensive graph statistics in JSON format
Python scripts for reproducing all figures in the manuscript
